{{Quote|Our primary target is the ''Blade of Beginnings''! It's a mythical, pricesless weapon that should fetch&mdash;|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], moments before the arrival of [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] and [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories" />}}
The '''Korasa job''' was the theft of two fake [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] relics that took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The theft==
{{Quote|Showtime, ''Boba''! We're coming up to the facility!|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories" />}}
[[File:Boba_Fett_new_helmet.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and his new [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces discovered two [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] artifacts on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Korasa]], in the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]], and took them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to be studied at a [[Jedi Research Facility]] in [[Timira City]]. Though the artifacts were in fact fakes, the Republic specialists at the facility initially believed one of the objects to be the legendary [[Blade of Beginnings]], and word of the find soon leaked to the outside world.

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] duo [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] and [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]] set out to steal the artifact for themselves, while the rival bounty trio [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]] launched their own attempted heist, hoping to seize the Blade of Beginnings and sell it. Fett and his squad made their way to Korasa and procured some [[moon dust]], a substance that was needed in order to deactivate the blade's [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking shield]], then journeyed to Timira [[City/Legends|City]] atop a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. There, Fett's team attacked defending Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], just as Dengar and Razzi arrived to commence their own raid, and Fett released a number of [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|pistoeka sabotage droids]] to distract his foes. Fett and his allies then took the artifacts and fled, while Dengar and Razzi were captured and imprisoned by the Republic forces.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Our rivals were ''good'', and I can always use a bigger, better team. We've both spent time in a ''Coruscant'' prison, so planning their jailbreak should be easy. After that, we can find ourselves some ''real'' work.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories" />}}
[[File:Boba_Fett_new_team.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and his new team]]
Following the Korasa job, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] kept one of the two [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] relics for himself, a highly valuable [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] capable of deflecting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts.

Impressed by the skills that his rivals had demonstrated, Fett planned to free the pair from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] captivity. He later added them up to his team and the five [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] all went together on a [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|new job]].<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref>
